mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.category_id AS categoryId, ss.name, ss.brief, ss.address, ss.longitude, ss.latitude, ss.images, ss.map_icon_url AS mapIconUrl, ss.cover_media_id AS coverMediaId, ss.trigger_radius_m AS triggerRadiusM, ss.trigger_enabled AS triggerEnabled, ss.audio_media_id AS audioMediaId, ss.audio_media_url AS audioMediaUrl, ss.opening_hours AS openingHours, ss.sort_no AS sortNo, ss.status, ss.created_at AS createdAt, ss.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM scenic_spot ss WHERE ss.status = 1 AND ss.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ss.sort_no ASC

SELECT ss.id, ss.NAME, ss.brief, ss.address, ss.longitude, ss.latitude, ss.trigger_radius_m AS triggerRadiusM, ss.opening_hours AS openingHours, ss.audio_media_id AS audioMediaId, ss.audio_media_url AS audioMediaUrl FROM scenic_spot ss WHERE ss.STATUS = 1 AND ss.deleted = 0 AND ss.trigger_enabled = 1 AND ss.audio_media_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ss.sort_no ASC
